lines.text: Many learners say: This is the car of my father.
Better: This is my father's car.
The second! This is my sister's bag.

data.wrong: This is the car of my father.

options: This is the bag of my sister.

native.hook: هل تقول “the car of my father”؟
native.tip: نقول «سيارة أبي»، أما هنا فنضيف 's إلى صاحب الشيء: “This is my father's car.” وليس “This is the car of my father.”

en.hook: Do you say “the car of my father”?
en.tip: In Arabic we say «سيارة أبي», but here we add 's to the owner: “This is my father's car.” not “This is the car of my father.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “This is the car of my father.” 😅 In Arabic we say «سيارة أبي», but here we add 's to the owner, so the right sentence is “This is my father's car.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
